title: MM6 Merchant
description: The native MM6 merchant: heavyset adult male with round pale face, short dark hair and a small plain muted cap. Long plain dark green tunic with long sleeves, restrained gold/brown trim on collar, shoulder seams and lower hem. Native blue collar insert, wide dark belt with pale metal clasp, tan/brown pouch and a plain wooden club hanging at the right hip, brown boots. Preserve his stocky broad torso, short legs, face, cap, exact hands and any native held equipment in each action. Faithful muted early fantasy pre-rendered art, plain cloth with fine texture and broad shallow folds, original dark tonal weight. No decorative embroidery, armor, new weapon or accessories.
regions: Generate only native green tunic and sleeves. These cloth regions recolor; protect blue collar insert, gold/brown trim, cap, skin, belt, pouch, boots and equipment.
